quests.name: Time To Strike
quests.text: Travel to Tarren Mill to deliver Deathstalker Lesh's message to High Executor Darthalia.

quests.name: Hinott's Assistance
quests.text: Wait for Serge Hinott to complete the cure.

quests.name: The Rescue
quests.text: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.

quests.name: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel
quests.text: Kill 10 Syndicate Rogues and 10 Syndicate Watchmen. Return to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill for your reward.

quests.name: Elixir of Suffering
quests.text: Apothecary Lydon of Tarren Mill wants 10 Gray Bear Tongues and some Creeper Ichor.

quests.name: Elixir of Suffering
quests.text: Give Umpi the Elixir of Suffering.

quests.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
quests.text: Kill 6 Hillsbrad Farmhands, 6 Hillsbrad Farmers, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Elixir of Pain
quests.text: Bring 10 vials of Mountain Lion Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Elixir of Pain
quests.text: Feed the Elixir of Pain to Stanley.

quests.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
quests.text: Kill 15 Hillsbrad Peasants and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Scout Support
quests.text: High Executor Darthalia wants you to deliver updated orders to Deathstalker Masoj, south of Tarren Mill, outside of Dun Garok.

quests.name: Valuable Vantages
quests.text: Deathstalker Masoj needs you to place the three Apothecary Vials on peaks around Hillsbrad Foothills and return to him.

quests.name: Souvenirs of Death
quests.text: Deathguard Samsa of Tarren Mill wants 30 Hillsbrad Human Skulls.

quests.name: Ott's Masterwork
quests.text: Watch as Ott forges your blade.

quests.name: The Moonsilver Blade
quests.text: Bring Ott's Masterwork to Trevan Rol in Silverpine Forest.

quests.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
quests.text: Kill Blacksmith Verringtan and 4 Hillsbrad Apprentice Blacksmiths.  Retrieve a shipment of iron and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
quests.text: Kill Magistrate Burnside and 5 Hillsbrad Councilmen. Destroy the Hillsbrad Proclamation. Steal the Hillsbrad Town Registry. Report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill afterwards.

quests.name: Hillsbrad's Hoard
quests.text: Place the Sealed Company Request you were given on the bookkeeping table within Hillsbrad's town hall.

quests.name: Brewer's Trade
quests.text: Deliver the bottles of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in southeast Hillsbrad Foothills, and bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.

quests.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
quests.text: Kill Foreman Bonds and 10 Hillsbrad Miners and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Dangerous!
quests.text: High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.

quests.name: Elixir of Agony
quests.text: Bring 6 Mudsnout Blossoms to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Elixir of Agony
quests.text: Take the Mudsnout Composite to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

quests.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
quests.text: Travel to Dun Garok and kill 8 Mountaineers, 4 Riflemen, 2 Priests and Captain Ironhill and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
notes: Every target is elite, so bring a group of about level 28 or higher.

quests.name: Elixir of Agony
quests.text: Bring the Mudsnout Mixture, a Strong Troll's Blood Potion, 5 Daggerspine Scales and 5 Torn Fin Eyes to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Elixir of Agony
quests.text: Bring a keg of Shindigger Stout to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Elixir of Agony
quests.text: Place the Tainted Keg on the rug for the captured farmers.

quests.name: Down the Coast
quests.text: Kill 10 Torn Fin Tidehunters and 10 Torn Fin Oracles for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore.

quests.name: Humbert's Sword
quests.text: Retrieve Deathguard Humbert's sword from Dun Garok and return it to him in Tarren Mill.
notes: The Dun Garok Mountaineers are elite, so the quest is marked as a group quest.

quests.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
quests.text: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Chef Jessen in Southshore.

quests.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
quests.text: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
quests.text: Take Darthalia's Sealed Commendation to Varimathras in the Undercity.

quests.name: Farren's Proof
quests.text: Collect 10 Murloc Heads from the murlocs on the Western Strand for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore.

quests.name: Farren's Proof
quests.text: Deliver the sack of murloc heads to Marshall Redpath in Southshore.

quests.name: Farren's Proof
quests.text: Speak with Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore.

quests.name: Stormwind Ho!
quests.text: Kill 10 Daggerspine Shorehunters and 10 Daggerspine Sirens for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore.

quests.name: Reassignment
quests.text: Deliver Farren's report to Major Samuelson in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: The Hammer May Fall
quests.text: Kill 8 Boulderfist Ogres and 10 Boulderfist Enforcers, then find Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost in Arathi Highlands.

quests.name: Helcular's Revenge
quests.text: Retrieve Helcular's Rod from the Yeti and bring it back to Novice Thaivand in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Helcular's Revenge
quests.text: Charge the Rod of Helcular with the powers of the Flame of Azel, Flame of Veraz and the Flame of Uzel.  Drive the charged rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore.

quests.name: Prison Break In
quests.text: Find the traitors and recover their artifacts, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Stone Tokens
quests.text: Bring 10 Worn Stone Tokens to Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Bracers of Binding
quests.text: Bring 4 Bracers of Earth Binding to Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Hints of a New Plague?
quests.text: Find Quae and Kinelory near the Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands.

quests.name: Infiltration
quests.text: Retrieve information about Gol'dir's whereabouts for Krusk in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Bartolo's Yeti Fur Cloak
quests.text: Bring Bartolo Ginsetti of Southshore a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak, Fine Thread and 10 clumps of Yeti Fur.

quests.name: Costly Menace
quests.text: Darren Malvew of Southshore wants you to kill 8 Mountain Lions and 10 Hulking Mountain Lions.

quests.name: Dalaran Patrols
quests.text: Kill 6 Dalaran Summoners and 12 Elemental Slaves, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Gol'dir
quests.text: Free Gol'dir then return to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

objectives.text: Find where Gol'dir is being held

quests.name: Blackmoore's Legacy
quests.text: Return the information gathered by Gol'dir to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Hints of a New Plague?
quests.text: Speak to Kinelory.

quests.name: Hints of a New Plague?
quests.text: Find the Forsaken Courier and bring back her Sealed Folder to Quae near the Go'Shek Farm.

quests.name: Hints of a New Plague?
quests.text: Protect Kinelory until she returns to Quae.

quests.name: Hints of a New Plague?
quests.text: Find Phin Odelic in Southshore.

quests.name: The Crown of Will
quests.text: Kill 10 Crushridge Maulers for Melisara in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Taretha's Gift
quests.text: Return Taretha's pendant to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
notes: You get the necklace when you accept the quest. You don't need to farm anything, just carry it to Krusk.

quests.name: WANTED: Baron Vardus
quests.text: Kill Baron Vardus and deliver his head to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Your First Horse
quests.text: Inspect the riding horses to choose your first mount.

quests.name: The Crown of Will
quests.text: Kill Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus and bring their heads to Melisara in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Lord Aliden Perenolde
quests.text: Kill Lord Aliden Perenolde and ask his mistress, Elysa, about Taretha's pendant.

quests.name: The Crown of Will
quests.text: Kill Mug'Thol, and return his head with the Crown of Will to Melisara in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: The Crown of Will
quests.text: Deliver the Crown of Will to Sharlindra in the Undercity.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ: Free Action Potion
quests.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ: Practice Lock
quests.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ: Pilferer's Gloves
quests.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

quests.name: Crashing the Wickerman Festival
quests.text: Locate the Forsaken's Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade. Return to Sergeant Hartman in Southshore once you've done so.

objectives.text: Scout out the Forsaken's Wickerman Festival.

notes: The quest only exists during Hallow's End, so Hartman is gone once the event ends.

quests.name: The Power of Pine
quests.text: Use a Stink Bomb Cleaner to remove any Forsaken Stink Bomb that's been dropped on Southshore. Return to Sergeant Hartman in Southshore when you're done.

quests.name: Ruined Kegs
quests.text: Return to Darkcaller Yanka at the Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade.
notes: You only get this quest during Hallow's End. It is the follow-up to placing the rotten eggs, and you start it by clicking the keg in the Alliance town of Southshore.

quests.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
quests.text: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits.  You also need to give her 50 gold to soothe her ruffled sensibilities.
notes: Turning in costs 50 gold, so carry it with you.
